Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 5.45 per unit (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month period, so we have included the AS-14404 index clause to make this duration possible. Our current offer is a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, based on 60-day payment terms, we can reduce our offer to EUR 5.54 per unit, with a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your updated terms and the movement on your side. 

As a loyal partner, we always strive to support your needs with our broad range of high-quality materials and reliable service. Our offer stands at a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

In response, we are prepared to lower our price to EUR 5.49 per unit for the package with 60-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, which includes a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This step reflects our commitment to finding a mutually acceptable agreement while maintaining the necessary index clause. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

It is always a pleasure working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we truly value our ongoing business relationship. We acknowledge your continued movement and are pleased to offer a further concession on the 60-day payment term. 

For the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.45 per unit. This represents a fair step towards your target while reflecting our current material coverage situation. 

To summarize, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
